title: Concrete Alibi
case_summary: Real estate tycoon Om Prakash was found crushed under a falling concrete block at his construction site in Gurugram at 18:00. It was ruled an accident, but the crane operator's log was faked. Om Prakash was building an illegal complex, and his partners wanted to cut him out of the billions.

victim.name: Om Prakash
victim.background: A corrupt builder who bribed officials and used substandard materials.
victim_relationships: Rashid (Manager): Om Prakash was going to frame him for the illegal building.
Sanjay (Partner): Om Prakash was stealing from the company.
Meera (Architect): Om Prakash ruined her reputation by using cheap materials.
Karan (Son): Om Prakash refused to pay off Karan's gambling debts.

solution.logical_rule: Rashid's alibi fails when the log, transfer, and camera feed are found.

suspects.name: Rashid Khan
suspects.motive: Om was going to frame him.
suspects.alibi: Claims he was in the office.
suspects.relationships: You hate Om. You despise Sanjay.

suspects.name: Sanjay Gupta
suspects.alibi: Claims he was at a golf game.
suspects.relationships: You think Rashid is uneducated. You hate Om.

suspects.name: Meera Deshmukh
suspects.alibi: Claims she was at her studio.
suspects.relationships: You hate corruption. You respect Rashid.

suspects.name: Karan Prakash
suspects.secret: He stole cash from the safe.

suspects.relationships: You are scared of your father. You think Sanjay is a snake.
